about: Venzon Law Firm, PC works from Delaware Avenue downtown and says it has practised in Western New York since 1984. Its own roster page separates its lawyers from its staff, which few firms do: two attorneys, one of counsel, and two people it lists under Staff.

50 reviews at 4.3. It explains eight stages of a matrimonial case including the attorney for the child, and it describes one route through a case, litigation, where most firms here describe several. It publishes no rate, no retainer figure and no flat fee.
